name: Personality
introduction: Some people are defined by what they own, what they know, or who they answer to. You are defined by who you are. Your temperament precedes you into a room and stays there after you have left, and the city has learned to expect it.
concept: You are who you are, and everyone around you has had to make room for it.

power_tag_questions.text: What is the trait everyone who knows you would name first?
What do you do better than anyone in the room, simply by being yourself?
examples: read a room in a second

power_tag_questions.text: What does your temperament let you get away with?
Who trusts you because of who you are, and what will they do for you?
examples: the night nurse owes me nothing and helps anyway

power_tag_questions.text: What reputation walks into the room before you do?
examples: the one who does not bluff

power_tag_questions.text: What do you never lose your nerve about?
What habit of yours turns out to be useful more often than it should?
What do you carry that says who you are without a word?
examples: a laugh you can hear two streets away

power_tag_questions.text: What do people ask you to do because no one else will?
What is the line you are known for holding?
examples: I do not lie to children

power_tag_rule.note: Answer question A, then two more of your choice.

weakness_tag_questions.text: What does your temperament cost you when it matters most?
Who has learned exactly how to use who you are against you?
examples: my sister knows which word does it

weakness_tag_questions.text: What do people assume about you that is wrong and useful to them?
What can you not make yourself do, even when you should?
examples: I cannot keep a secret from her

motivation.intro: Write the statement about yourself that you keep proving, to the city and to yourself.
examples: I am the one who stays.
I do not owe anyone an explanation.
I can be trusted with the worst of it.
motivation.rule: When you act against this Identity, mark a crack. When the track fills, the theme breaks and you replace it.

title_guidance: Name the part of yourself this theme is about, in the words someone else would use for you.

improvements.name: Force of Character
improvements.effect: Take an additional power tag for this theme.

improvements.name: Unshakable
improvements.effect: Once per session, ignore a status of tier 2 or less that targets your composure.

improvements.name: Known Quantity
improvements.effect: When you invoke your reputation to open a door, take a +1 ongoing for the scene.

improvements.name: Second Wind
improvements.effect: Once per session, erase one crack from this theme by living up to your Identity in public.

improvements.name: That Is Who I Am
improvements.effect: Unlock a custom move for this theme, written with the MC.

meta.source: Lantern in the Mist - Sample Themebooks
